session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bull Trend from Open, Deep Pullback Then Trend Resumption' (overnight ET+13 abacus chart, close chip 6987). Bull trend from open to a micro double top (~6978), deep two-leg pullback to a higher low double bottom (00:30 low ~6957), then consecutive tight range breakouts and bull trend resumption with consecutive wedges two legs up into a tight trading range into the close near the all-time high.
